summary.short: Italian data protection authority (Garante) decision of 11 April 2023 ordering OpenAI L.L.C., controller of ChatGPT, to implement nine measures for people connecting from Italy: information notices, objection and erasure tools, a legal-basis change and age verification. Suspends the earlier processing limitation once measures 1 to 7 are met.
summary.long: Decision of 11 April 2023 of the Italian data protection authority (Garante) under GDPR Art. 58(2)(d), addressed to OpenAI L.L.C. as controller of personal data processed through ChatGPT. Points 1 to 9 require: a publicly posted information notice for data subjects whose data were used to train algorithms, whether or not they are users; objection, rectification or erasure tools for people connecting from Italy; a link to the user information notice in the registration flow, viewed by Italian users including registered ones; a change of the legal basis for training on users' data, removing contract and relying on consent or legitimate interest; an age gate for Italian users at reactivation; a plan by 31 May 2023 for age verification excluding under-13s and minors without parental consent, to start by 30 September 2023; and an information campaign by 15 May 2023. Measures 1 to 7 must be complied with by 30 April 2023. On compliance, the decision suspends the temporary limitation on processing adopted on 30 March 2023. The decision is without prejudice to further measures after the ongoing fact-finding and to action for infringements. The controller must report on steps taken. Failure to respond to Art. 58 requests carries the fine under Art. 83(5)(e) GDPR. Appeal lies to the ordinary court within thirty days of notification, or sixty days if the appellant resides abroad.

relations.note: Orders issued under Art. 58(2)(d); information request under Art. 58(1); suspension refers to Art. 58(2)(f); fine reference to Art. 83(5)(e); appeal under Art. 78.

evidence.quote: IL GARANTE PER LA PROTEZIONE DEI DATI PERSONALI

notes: The document contains an Italian and an English version, and their wording differs in places (e.g., point 4 'debbano prendere visione' versus 'to require ... to view'; point 8 age wording; point 1 scope of ChatGPT/API features). Quotes are taken from the Italian text. Points 1 to 7 must be met by 30 April 2023 and point 8 by 31 May 2023 (plan) with implementation from 30 September 2023 at the latest; point 9 has a campaign deadline of 15 May 2023. The suspension of the earlier limitation takes effect only on compliance with points 1 to 7, and further measures are reserved. The only penalty reference is to Art. 83(5)(e) for failure to respond to Art. 58 requests. The earlier decision is cited as n. 112 in the text but as [9870832] in the Documenti citati list; the text does not reconcile the two identifiers.

obligations.summary: Publish on its website an information notice for data subjects whose data were collected for algorithm training, whether or not they are users, covering processing, underlying logic, rights and other Regulation elements (Art. 12 terms). obligations.summary: Provide on its website, at least to data subjects connecting from Italy (users or not), a tool to exercise the right to object to processing of data obtained from third parties for algorithm training and service provision. Compliance due by 30 April 2023 per premises.

evidence.quote: di uno strumento attraverso il quale possano esercitare il diritto di opposizione

obligations.summary: Provide on its website, at least to data subjects connecting from Italy (users or not), a tool to request and obtain rectification of inaccurately processed personal data in content generation, or erasure where rectification is not possible under state-of-the-art technology. Compliance due by 30 April 2023 per premises.

evidence.quote: di uno strumento attraverso il quale chiedere e ottenere la correzione di eventuali dati personali

obligations.summary: Include a link to the user information notice in the registration flow, placed so that it must be viewed before registration, including by already-registered users at first access after any reactivation of the service. Compliance due by 30 April 2023 per premises.

obligations.summary: Change the legal basis for processing users’ personal data for algorithm training, removing any reference to contract and relying on consent or legitimate interest, with an accountability assessment. Compliance due by 30 April 2023 per premises.

obligations.summary: Provide on its website, at least to users connecting from Italy, an easily accessible tool to object to processing of their data for algorithm training, where the legal basis chosen under point 5 is legitimate interest. Compliance due by 30 April 2023 per premises.
